contract_snapshot.title: Receiving goods: N assets from one form, then serial numbers
contract_snapshot.interface:
final class IntakeService. Constructor: __construct(\Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager, \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\TagGenerator $tagGenerator). Service 'hwdesk.intake' (registered).
createBatch(array $values, int $count): array -- list of saved \Drupal\hwdesk\Entity\Asset, in tag order. $values keys (all optional except type and model): type (string, required), model (string, required, non-empty after trim), manufacturer (string), condition (string, default 'new'), location (int entity id or NULL), tags (list<int>), invoice (int or NULL), price (string|NULL), warranty_until (string 'Y-m-d' or NULL), cost_center (string), notes (string). $count < 1 or > 500 -> \InvalidArgumentException; missing/empty type or model -> \InvalidArgumentException. Each asset: 'tag' => $tagGenerator->next($type), 'status' => 'in_stock', 'holder' => NULL, serial_number empty; unknown keys ignored; create via $entityTypeManager->getStorage('hwdesk_asset')->create([...]) and save each.
setSerialNumbers(array $serialsByAssetId): void -- keys = asset ids (int), values = serial strings; trim each; blank values are skipped (not written). Validate everything before writing anything: unknown asset id -> \InvalidArgumentException; the same serial (case-insensitive) twice in the input -> \InvalidArgumentException; a serial already used (case-insensitive) by a different existing asset (entity query on hwdesk_asset, 'serial_number' with a case-insensitive comparison, accessCheck(FALSE)) -> \InvalidArgumentException whose message contains that serial. Then set serial_number on each asset and save.
File header: <?php + declare(strict_types=1); namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Service; final class; constructor property promotion with readonly; no \Drupal:: static calls (everything is injected); no other new files.
